notes.title: ONLY 1 DAY LEFT! GAME RELEASE SCHEDULE 🌍
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/27b9ad62543f47336978072a56216116ce618121.png

You won't be able to hide from this release! FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE is coming out tomorrow, and we'll finally have a chance to share the results of our work with you! ❤️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE
We know that you, our beloved players, have been waiting for this for a long time. Many of you are from different corners of the world, so we have prepared a release map in different time zones for countries and regions. Explore it carefully and set your alarm clocks so you can be the first to break into dorm life and enjoy all the delights of the school of magic 🔥

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/5197b693658bc04556ea57ce33527fda997c793d.png

⏰ When is the release time?

Each region has its own launch time, and we don't want you to guess and figure it out yourself. That's why we've put everything together in a handy image — just find your region and remember the time!

🔹 September 12
9 AM - Los Angeles

10 AM - Mexico 

11 AM - Houston

12 PM - New York

1 PM - San Paulo

3 PM - London

6 PM - Varsovia and Cape Town

7 PM - Moscow

🔹 September 13

1 AM - Seoul and Tokyo

💖 Thank you for being with us all this time, for your support, reviews, and help in making the game better. Tomorrow we will finally meet you at FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE — and we promise this adventure will be unforgettable.

In the meantime, get ready, add the game to your wishlists, and charge your magic wands, because tomorrow it all begins for real!

notes.title: Yoshima: Hentai Simulator — bugfixes and more 😎
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45283720/cb8c5b05d110b653c52178e603c389e4b33686cc.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3298250/Yoshima_Hentai_Simulator

🍑 Long time no see, neighbor!  🍑

So, this game is finally released! We want to thank you for your proactive feedback. We heard each and every one of your pieces of feedback, so we've already fixed most of bugs and errors! 🔥

Today we're going to talk more about what has changed since our release, and we'll give you a sneak peek at some interesting things. 😏

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45283720/4cf24006cc988ba1fdbeec951bd7ad88fea11469.png

Let's start with the major changes:
 Reduced the number of days from 90 to 75
 Reduced the rental price
 Fixed autosaves
 Fixed bugs in the “Truth or Dare” and “Sleep” events
 Improved image quality ( also minimized blurring in the gallery)
 Added the ability to hide the interface using “spacebar”
 Made it easier to get a good ending
 Fixed the sound in some h-scenes
 Expanded the activities descriptions and mini-game guides
 Added a hint in the "Waiter" mini-game
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45283720/61ae7077c1b444e4ca2549ace5ed638bd06996f9.jpg
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45283720/42cdf71656c10b39e96ead4b7a4b44312da823fe.jpg

We're also working hard on the trading cards. How's that? There will be more coming soon! 😍

Meanwhile, the Spring Sale is still going on! Hurry up to buy TopHouse games for a good price 👇👇

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40941/TopHouse_Games_Bundle

notes.title: Yoshima: Hentai Simulator — Last devlog before release! 🎉
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45283720/81d43fc3a7a909f44a7248e1f145c28364024d88.png

💗 Yoshima welcomes you, neighbor! 💗
As you already know, the release date for Yoshima: Hentai Simulator is March 7th. Our team is working night and day to deliver the perfect game straight to you. We’re sure it’ll go without any problems. 😎

Get ready to return to the familiar apartment with a girl that you’ve… probably already got very close with the last three demo builds. 😏   

To not forget the release date for sure - wishlist our game! This way, we will send you a notification when this cutie appears on Steam. 😻

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3298250/Yoshima_Hentai_Simulator/

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45283720/ff3bcfd3ea667826157a6521427c60252ffca3dc.png

From the moment we’ve announced the project, four months have passed, and a lot happened since: builds, new static and animated scenes, and let’s not forget about mini-games! You’ve provided us with necessary feedback, and we tried our best to make the game better.

The 40,000 wishlist milestone is almose done! We’ve got just a little bit more until we start working on a DLC! 
🌺 SUPPORT YOSHIMA 🌺

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45283720/593e1dea4f73890223426e1699525fe589967bbf.png

Thank you for staying with us! See you on Steam, on March 7th, 4PM UTC (8AM PST)! 😘
